claims: Acceptance-type strategies show d = 0.30 on average against d = 0.03 for suppression, with "very high variability between the results of particular studies" [1].
Acceptance is not proven on felt experience: one study found it "can be ineffective on the level of emotional experience" [1].
Read the Webb meta-analysis behind [1] for who benefits and who does not.
